1. Technical Specifications

  • HDMI Version: 2.0

  • Length: 3 Meters

  • Bandwidth: 18Gbps

  • Cable Type: High-Speed HDMI with Ethernet

Resolution & Refresh Rates

  • 4K Ultra HD: 3840 x 2160 @ 60Hz

  • 2K Quad HD: 2560 x 1440 @ 144Hz

  • Full HD: 1920 x 1080 @ 240Hz

  • 3D Support: Support for 3D video formats

Audio & Visual Features

  • HDR Support: Static HDR for enhanced color and brightness

  • Audio Return Channel (ARC): Supported

  • Audio Channels: Up to 32 audio channels

  • Chroma Subsampling: Supports 4:4:4, 4:2:2, and 4:2:0

Build & Compatibility

  • Connector: Gold-plated HDMI Type A

  • Shielding: Multi-layer shielding to prevent signal loss over 10m

  • Backward Compatibility: Fully compatible with HDMI 1.4 and older versions
